supported_fields.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 152 — "Dyspo's Wanted Man"; Ultimate Finish reward route
supported_fields.mechanics: Forward rolling dash/kick that cancels weak Ki Blasts; additional input spends 100 more Ki for Justice Crush's Ki wave. Current skill documentation reports approximately 15% damage for the kick and another approximately 15% for the follow-up wave.

limits: The maintained repository records a 40% Ultimate-Finish bonus route; exact individual drop behavior remains unresolved.
